values_policy: Names, classes, path templates and loaders only. No value, hash of a value, or host-specific path belongs in this file.
file_format: One provider per file. `export NAME=value` lines (quote a value containing spaces). Every current repository parser accepts this form; pit-availability/measure.py accepts only this form.

entries.label: Alpaca paper broker key pair
entries.rotation: On any exposure trigger; before any live-scope work; unconditionally once after adopting this layout because broker-prefixed names were observed in a launcher environment on 2026-09-23.
entries.notes: Paper-only keys. Live keys are out of scope for this repository; live trading is handled outside it. ALPACA_API_KEY/ALPACA_SECRET_KEY are read-only fallback names in pit-availability/measure.py and are never written.

entries.label: SEC/EDGAR declared contact identity
entries.rotation: Change only when the monitored contact changes. Receipts store only its SHA-256.
entries.notes: Private personal data, not an authentication secret. The catalyst-provenance recipe sources this file with set -a; that is accepted for a contact string only.

entries.label: Databento API key
entries.rotation: Quarterly and on any exposure trigger.
entries.notes: Not wired into any recipe yet (catalog example only). Create the file only when the paid key is adopted.

entries.label: Typesafe live-judge API key
entries.rotation: Quarterly and on any exposure trigger.
entries.notes: Only the live-judge mode needs it, in that one process. Another project's own Typesafe file is outside this inventory.

entries.label: OmniRoute local gateway inference key
entries.rotation: Regenerate in the gateway on any exposure trigger.
entries.notes: Only for the optional routing recipe.

entries.label: Local Grafana admin account and secret key (self-generated)
entries.rotation: Delete the file and rerun observability/backends/configure.py, then restart the Grafana user unit.
entries.notes: Generated with 0600 by configure.py and never supplied by the operator. Known inconsistency: the Grafana unit uses EnvironmentFile=, so these values are in that service's process environment. Accepted because Grafana listens on loopback and normal observation uses anonymous Viewer.

entries.label: Host nativestack generation key (self-generated)
entries.rotation: Regenerate through the host's own nativestack-generation service.
entries.notes: Host-local; no code in this repository reads it. Listed so the checker and the agent deny rules cover it.

entries.label: Claude Code native sign-in
entries.rotation: `/logout` in Claude Code, then sign in again.
entries.notes: On macOS the client may keep this in the login Keychain and the file can be absent. Never copied between hosts.

entries.label: GitHub CLI native sign-in
loaders: git credential helper via `gh auth setup-git`
entries.rotation: `gh auth refresh`, or `gh auth logout` then `gh auth login`; revoke stale tokens in GitHub settings.
entries.notes: When gh stores the token in an OS keyring, hosts.yml holds no token. Scripts never export `gh auth token`.

entries.label: IB Gateway / TWS interactive login
entries.rotation: Change the IBKR password in the IBKR portal.
entries.notes: Nothing is stored. TWS_*/IBKR_* names stay unset; worker_env_check.sh asserts they never reach workers.

entries.label: GitHub Actions secret FOUNDATION_RESTORE_FIXTURE_20260920 and the per-job github.token
entries.rotation: `gh secret set FOUNDATION_RESTORE_FIXTURE_20260920` from your own terminal.
entries.notes: Held by GitHub; no local copy. No personal access token is stored as a repository secret.
